messages.text: 10-yr auction tailed like crazy, 1:00 stop-through the other way. Printed 4.2bp wide of WI. Curve is bear steepening, offers getting hit across the belt.
Steven, are we carrying any net DV01 in the 7-10 bucket right now? Want to know before I answer the CFO's office.
Short about 180k DV01 in 10s from the Thursday client flow, partially hedged with futures. Net is flat-ish after the TY roll adjustment.
RiskEngine intraday VaR on rates is up about 12% since 9:45 on vol alone. Still inside limit, haven't pinged anyone yet.
Thanks Angelica. What's the usage against the rates desk limit now?
71% of the limit. Was 63% at the open. I'll flag if it crosses 80.
Heads up, TradeBlotter P&L on the rates book looks stale. Last refresh 10:08. Anyone else seeing that?
Same here, P&L lag on my side too. Likely PricingSvc catching up on the repricing after the auction. VaR numbers look current though.
OMS is fine, working a 50mm buy in the 5s as a rebalance. Waiting for the bid-offer to settle before I go heavier.
Keep the clip size modest while spreads are this wide. Don't chase the tail.
Agreed. Slicing in 10mm pieces, 5s are cheapening about 1bp every few minutes.
Update: TradeBlotter P&L refreshed, rates book down about 220k on the day. Consistent with the move in the curve.
OK, nothing to escalate. Angelica, send me a snapshot of the DV01 ladder at noon and again after the close.
